Legacy campaign

A Different Kind of Growth (2042–2061)

The final generation inherits nearly two centuries of decisions. Meet growing demand while keeping the whole term within a carbon budget.

Explore the Legacy campaign↗ See what’s at stake ↓

Build one utility across nine generations. This chapter is part of that journey.

Location
A fictional California utility
Starts in
2042
Generation
20 years

The situation

Your starting point

The ninth and final Legacy generation takes over in 2042. The company is the result of eight previous handovers, with the fleet, customers and financial position you carried through them.

Your featured objective is a cumulative emissions budget covering the whole twenty-year term. A clean final year cannot erase emissions from the years before it. Growing demand makes the timing of each investment part of that budget.

The choices

What will you do?

  1. 01

    Spend the carbon budget over time

    Watch accumulated emissions as well as the current fuel mix. Earlier reductions leave more room for difficult periods later in the term.

  2. 02

    Supply the next wave of demand

    Plan capacity and demand measures together as electricity use grows. Check that the cleaner fleet can serve customers across the full day.

  3. 03

    Finish with a viable company

    Keep customer retention, affordability and debt alongside the climate objective. Two centuries of expansion end with a utility that still has people to serve.

Put your plan to the test

Follow your company to 2061 and see what your long sequence of choices adds up to.

Open the campaign setup to begin, or continue your existing company. Later generations inherit the choices you made before them.
